sf.rate_limit: Single concurrent crawl per SF GUI (D-SF-10 pre-flight check enforces)

tools.description: Trigger a new SF crawl. Accepts URL list + optional crawl_config_file_path. Returns crawl_id for progress polling. v1.8 Phase 1 D-SF-12.
Poll progress of an in-flight crawl by crawl_id. Returns percent + URL count + IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/FAILED state.

Export an SF report by category ('Cat:Subcat' colon form from sf_list_available_reports) to file_path (relative to allowed_directory). Args: category (required), file_path, data_fields, export_type ('CSV'|'NDJSON'). Operates on the currently-loaded crawl. build_export_plan maps engine canonicals (issues_overview_report, redirect_chains, orphan_pages) to this tool.

Export an SF bulk export by category (from sf_list_available_bulk_exports) to file_path. Same arg shape as sf_generate_report: category (required), file_path, data_fields, export_type ('CSV'|'NDJSON'). build_export_plan maps link/content canonicals (all_inlinks, all_outlinks, all_anchor_text, near_duplicates_report, exact_duplicates_report) to this tool.

Export the URL list for a named SEO element + filter to file_path (CSV by default; NO export_type arg). Args: seo_element_name (required enum incl. Internal/H1/H2/Page Titles/Meta Description/Canonicals/Directives/Images/Hreflang/Sitemaps/Structured Data/Pagination/Response Codes/Search Console), filter_name (required; 'All' valid for every element), file_path, segment_name, data_fields, start_index, max_rows. build_export_plan maps the majority of canonicals (internal_all, page_titles_all, h1_all, indexability, crawl_depth, etc.) to this tool.
List currently-tracked crawls (running + recently-completed). Used by orchestrator for resume semantics.
Pre-flight probe — returns the SF GUI's currently-configured allowed_directory. Orchestrator compares against project.config.sf.mcp.allowed_directory for drift detection.

Load a previously-identified completed SF crawl by crawl_id (instanceDirName) into the SF GUI so element/report exports operate on it. Native SfMcpClient.load_crawl wrapper; used by the D-SF-11 opt-in live-crawl path in schema-audit / on-page-audit / tech-audit / internal-links.
